rv.q: Stork's production is a very solid staging, hampered a tad by the size of the Paramount Theatre, but deftly cast with performers like Andrea Prestinario.
Their radical hospitality inspired “Come From Away,” running through Oct. 12 in an exhilarating production at Aurora’s Paramount Theatre.
It is a wonderful way to end this well told story.
COME FROM AWAY is a truly cathartic experience about the triumph of humanity over hatred.
This is a beautiful, necessary show—one that leaves you both heartbroken and uplifted, and one I’ll carry with me for a long time.
The Tony Award-winning musical by composer/lyricist/writers Irene Sankoff and David Hein is a tonic for troubled times...
If you want to learn about a real-life tale of communion, go see “Come From Away.”
You will be crying and dancing through the finale with the superb cast.

cn.t: Critics praise this uplifting ensemble musical as life-affirming and emotionally powerful, celebrating human decency through Gander's true 9/11 story. The heartwarming production earns acclaim for its transformative message of compassion over tragedy.
